profile.headline: Maintenance Technician
profile.summary: 20+ years’ experience developing, coordinating, applying and managing original and effective processes and solutions related to information technology, manufacturing, mechanical engineering, construction & business systems. Hard-working, detail-oriented, well-rounded individual with eclectic skill sets seeks dynamic position in skills-related field.

positions.title: Fiber Optic Technician
positions.description: Google Fiber Project.....underground drop placement, hand trenching drops, mechanical and/or fusion splicing,  OTDR Testing, placement, premise wiring, CPE installation, and customer education. responsible for the installation and customer experience of new Broadband integrated digital TV, high speed Internet and voice services

positions.title: Manufacturing Production Technician
positions.description:
Forklift operations loading/ unloading tractor trailers 
Performed progressive assembly operations in warehouse
transferred flexibly among a variety of production job assignments.
Collaborated in a team environment whilst adhering to all attendance and safety rules, regulations, product quality and equipment requirements. Lockout/ tagout trained.

positions.title: Field Service Technician
positions.description:
Installed and upgraded residential & commercial cable, phone and internet systems.
· Provided technology service and support whilst ensuring customer satisfaction at the highest level.
· Worked independently and trained customers on all aspects of running their systems by providing thorough explanations.
· Monitored and managed vehicle stock and learned about new technology, as needed.

positions.title: IT Coordinator & Purchasing Manager
positions.description:
Maintained computer systems, security networks and associated hardware.
Performed LAN maintenance, and computer & communications hardware and software installations.
Active directory administrator for all workstations and users.
Provided data processing, purchasing, accounts payables & receivables, and capital expense tracking services

positions.title: Maintenance Manager
positions.description:
Performed routine maintenance of 100-bed facility and associated entities.
Responsible for painting, dry walling, installing and repairing electrical and plumbing infrastructure, flooring and framing.
Maintained air handling systems and boilers.
